question: Which is the third layer of soil from the top?
solution:
The correct answer is **Substratum**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **soil** is the** topmost layer of the earth's crust** mainly composed of **organic minerals and rock particles** that support life.
 
• **Soil profile** is defined as the** vertical section** of the soil from the** ground surface downwards **to where the soil meets the underlying rock.
 
• The layers of the soil are known as** Soil horizons.**
 
• They are generally represented by the letters **O,A,C,E,B and R.**
 
• The **organic matter** is the **O-horizon,** followed by it the **top soil (A), subsoil (B)** and the** substratum (C**).
 
• So from the topsoil the third layer is the **Substratum i.e. the C-horizon.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** E horizon **is the layer consisting of nutrients leached out from **O-A horizons.**
 
• The **R Horizon** is a **compact and cemented layer.**
